name: Cloud Sync Indicator
description:
Status indicator for the “OneDrive Client for Linux” (abraunegg) running as a systemd user service: status, recent messages, pause/start, resync and sign-in through a dedicated sign-in window.

Clipboard access: only if the sign-in window is not used, the sign-in response address can be read from the clipboard by clicking “Sign in from clipboard”. It is passed only to the local client.

Not an official product; not affiliated with Microsoft. OneDrive is a trademark of Microsoft.
